title: TLS certificate hostname bypass when the IP is written fullwidth digits
vulnerabilityInformation: A flaw was discovered in TLS hostname verification that allowed a certificate without a matching IP address to authenticate connections when the host was written using non-ASCII characters. The verification function failed to recognize such hosts as IP addresses and instead matched them against certificate DNS names and Common Name. A certificate issued for one IP endpoint could be accepted for a different IP endpoint. This regression affected specific versions of the runtime.
